svg.aria-label: Diagram: one home server running Unraid and Docker hosts Home Assistant, Frigate, Immich, Nextcloud, Jellyfin, Scrypted, remote access tools and databases, each shown with its icon. Devices around the house feed it, and it reaches the tablet, TV, phones, lights and fans, and me when I am away
